subcategory_text: Data elements can be accessed for alteration.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-7 (Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity), AC-3 (Access Enforcement)
implementation_examples: Provide authorised requestors with a documented path to alter data elements under recorded change-control
Capture before/after versions, author, timestamp, and reason for the change
Align alteration with downstream consumers of the data so updates propagate consistently
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data elements can be altered on request
Determine whether changes are recorded with before/after values, author, timestamp, and reason
Determine whether alteration flows through downstream consumers
Determine whether change-control approval is proportionate to the sensitivity of the change
